Name: Pine Spruce and Goods (Updated 1.6)
Author: yourdorkbrains
Description:
Fixed so all you need to this to work is Content Patcher, even the tree shake is cp! Well besides the farm type manager still is needed to spawn pine spruce

This mod adds Pine Spruce aka the branch with pine needles and some custom made goods!

With this pack you are able to shake any pine tree and get the Pine Spruce there is a 80% chance. 

[i]Artisan Goods made from pine spruce or pinecone:[/i]
[b]Conifer Infused Vodka - Keg (2 Pine Spruce)[/b]
[b]Pinecone Jam- Preserves Jar (3 Pine Cones)[/b]
[b]Pine Syrup - Preserves Jar- (3 Pine Spruce)[/b]
[b]Pine Needle Tincture - Oil Maker (2 Pine Spruce)
Pine Needles Tea - Cooking recipe that is default

[/b]Also you can forage for pine needles but they do not show up often as you can easily get them from shaking a tree.

All images drawn by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/114018673]Aimon111[/url][b], [/b]I cannot thank them enough!

2.1 Fixed preserve jar breaking
